subject: post
title: (R)POST.------MTH.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 115 (T(AF)M-19). POST (postulation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MTH (methodology) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From DYM-F: C-AF-ALGN (composite affinity alignment). From CRTF-D: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From C-AF-ALGN: PART (participation). From T-C-IMP: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From WO-EXP-PRI: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: AF-NT (affinity nature).
